wfHint: Drag across the waveform to choose the part to keep, or type the times below.
slmIntro: Press Start and allow microphone access to see the relative sound level around you.
slmDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
slmNote: This is a relative meter, not a calibrated sound-level instrument: the decibel value is referenced to digital full scale, so it depends on your microphone and its gain. Use it to compare loudness or spot noise, not for legal or safety measurements. Audio is analysed in your browser and never recorded or uploaded.
mosWaiting: Add an image, then drag over the areas you want to hide.
mosNote: Drag across a face, a number plate or any private detail to pixelate or blur it. The image is edited on a canvas in your browser and never uploaded. Download the result as a PNG.
gridWaiting: Add an image to slice it into a grid of squares.
gridNote: The image is cut into equal pieces on a canvas in your browser. Download them one by one or as a single ZIP, then post them in order for a seamless nine-square grid. Nothing is uploaded.
zwCarrier: Carrier text — the visible message people will read…
zwSecret: Secret text to hide inside it…
zwPasted: Paste the watermarked text here to reveal its hidden message…
zwNeedSecret: Type a secret message to hide first
zwNone: No hidden message was found in this text.
zwNote: The secret is encoded as zero-width Unicode characters (U+200B/U+200C) wrapped in word-joiners. They are invisible and survive ordinary copy-paste, but any editor that strips formatting or normalises Unicode will remove them. This is obfuscation, not encryption — do not hide passwords or sensitive data with it.
cssNote: Drag the sliders and watch the preview and the CSS update live. Copy the CSS into your stylesheet. Everything is computed in your browser.
jsvgInput: Paste JSON here — an object or array becomes a structure tree…
jsvgBadJson: That is not valid JSON. Check for a missing comma or quote.
jsvgNote: The JSON is parsed and laid out as a left-to-right structure tree, drawn entirely in your browser. Download it as an SVG you can drop into docs or slides, or copy the markup. Large arrays are capped at 40 branches and 8 levels deep to keep the diagram readable.
jsvgHint: Enter JSON and press Render to draw its structure as an SVG tree.
encInput: Type or paste the text to encrypt or decrypt…
encNoSubtle: This browser has no Web Crypto support. A secure (https) page is required.
encBadCipher: That is not valid encrypted text.
encWrongPass: Could not decrypt — wrong passphrase or corrupted text.
encPassHint: The same passphrase is needed to decrypt. It is never stored or sent anywhere.
encNote: AES-256-GCM with a PBKDF2-derived key (150,000 iterations, SHA-256). The random salt and IV are packed into the output, so the passphrase alone decrypts it. Everything runs in your browser via the Web Crypto API — nothing is uploaded.
camIntro: Test your camera, microphone and screen — all locally. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
camRunning: Camera is live. If you can see yourself, the camera works.
camDenied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
camMicRunning: Speak or tap the microphone — the level bar should move.
camMicDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
camScreenHint: Tap anywhere to change colour and look for stuck or dead pixels.
camNote: The camera preview and microphone level run entirely in your browser through getUserMedia and the Web Audio API. No video or audio is recorded, saved or sent anywhere. Use the screen test to spot dead pixels on a monitor or phone display.
teleInput: Paste your script or speech here…
teleNote: Paste your speech, set the font size and scroll speed, then press Start. Mirror flips the text for a beam-splitter teleprompter rig, and Fullscreen fills the display. Your script stays in this browser tab and is never uploaded.
